agents.name: Lab test
agents.description: Starts a lab test of an audit's page: Lighthouse run by Google PageSpeed Insights (performance, accessibility, best practices, SEO). Answers 202 at once; the test takes ~25 s to 2+ minutes — then read it with lab_result. Does not change the audit score. Answers **202** at once; the test runs for ~25 s to over 2 minutes and its summary is stored in the audit (`summary.lab.<strategy>`), so it comes back in `GET /api/audits/:id`, in the tab and in the shared report. It does not change the audit score. Calling again while the same strategy is running does not start a second test. Limits: 4 tests at a time on the server, 6 per network per hour and 500 per day for the whole product. Free: no x402 charge.

assessment.explanation:
I found three tools that can perform a web page performance audit using Lighthouse. 

*   The "Lab test" tool starts a lab test of an audit's page using Lighthouse run by Google PageSpeed Insights, covering performance, accessibility, best practices, and SEO.
*   "Request a free website audit" by Upforge also runs real PageSpeed/Lighthouse analysis.
*   The "stack.health_audit" tool provides Google Lighthouse scores for performance, accessibility, SEO, and best practices as part of its health audit. None of these matches is marked as able to start a Darwin thread. Recheck each agent's readiness before using Act.
